item.create_enigma.extinguished_cake.too: You always wondered what a blaze cake tastes like, so you worked out a way. Now you can finally try it
Have you ever tried feeding it to a blaze?
advancement.create_enigma.gods_glance.ti: The Gaze of the God of All Machines
advancement.create_enigma.gods_glance.de: This is His relic... you have drawn His attention. No, this is madness
advancement.create_enigma.mystic_grace.d: You marvel at the power of the Enigma. No no no, this is undoubtedly madness
create_enigma.disguised_motor.summary: I reckon this is a Creative Motor.
create_enigma.disguised_motor.aside: But what is reckoning good for?
create_enigma.blueprint.summary: He still remembers what He is meant to look like.
create_enigma.blueprint.detail: He was made, He was lost, but He was never unmade. He longs to be again, though He has no strength left to be.
create_enigma.enigma_core.layer.low: It runs on disguises. It knows. It does not care.
create_enigma.enigma_core.layer.middle: Six genuine Creative Motors. Only the seventh is missing.
create_enigma.enigma_core.layer.high: All seven. This is how it was built.
create_enigma.enigma_core.unknown: Part of the machine is not loaded; cannot tell right now.
create_enigma.enigma_core.no_template: Structure template is missing from the jar - this is a bug.
create_enigma.enigma_wrench.subject: the Enigma
create_enigma.wrench.not_picky: It has been hungry too long. It is not picky any more.
create_enigma.wrench.promoted: The core has taken the chest's place. It is still not complete.
create_enigma.wrench.offerings_empty: You have not shown enough sincerity
create_enigma.wrench.offerings_impure: He does not like it. Take it away.
create_enigma.ponder.tag.enigma.descript: God of the first of all machines, cast down your gaze upon us
The Work of God, First of All Machines, Enigma
create_enigma.ponder.enigma_wrench_1.tex: To call upon the great God of All Machines...
...you must first take up His relic: the Enigma Wrench.
create_enigma.ponder.enigma_wrench_2.tex: You catch some revelation from the whispering,
the Enigma Wrench is no different from a Wrench in substance,
but it holds far more precise components.
You also make out some information:
create_enigma.ponder.creative_hand_crank: Generating Rotational Force with a Creative Hand Crank
A Creative Hand Crank lets players apply rotational force by hand
Hold Right-Click to rotate it Counter-Clockwise
Sneak and Hold Right-Click to rotate it Clockwise
Compared with a Hand Crank, a Creative Hand Crank provides far greater rotational force
...even so, you still have to crank it yourself
create_enigma.ponder.enigma_machine.head: Enigma
create_enigma.ponder.enigma_machine.text: In the dread whispering, a mystifying vision pours into your mind
No. This is not Create at all
There is no logic to this
But you will come to understand Him.
The work of the God of All Machines is not to be defiled.
create_enigma.ponder.mystic_machine.head: The Mystic Machine
create_enigma.ponder.mystic_machine.text: This is the thing called the “Mystic Machine”
You do not know where it came from, nor what it is
But you feel it will reveal a strange new world to you
create_enigma.ponder.mystic_offerings.te: They say the Mystic Machine favours strange things
Things of no use to the new generation of engineers, long lost to history
Never mind. The revelation has already given you everything
The flywheel: emblem of turning, and of standing still...
The Extinguished Cake: emblem of burning, and of going out...
...and the Hand of God: emblem of machinery, and of tools.
create_enigma.ponder.mystic_call.text_1: To earn the regard of the Mystic Machine...
create_enigma.ponder.mystic_call.text_3: And once you are devout enough...
create_enigma.ponder.mystic_call.text_4: ...call upon Him with the Enigma Wrench
